title: Lyondellbasell Industries Nv (LYB) Holder Meritage Portfolio Management Has Lowered Its Holding as Shares Declined; Plancorp Increased Its Position in Randgold Res LTD (GOLD) as Share Price Rose
text:
Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Lyondellbasell Industries Nv (LYB) Holder Meritage Portfolio Management Has Lowered Its Holding as Shares Declined; Plancorp Increased Its Position in Randgold Res LTD (GOLD) as Share Price Rose 
March 10, 2018 - By Hugh Holland 
Plancorp Llc increased its stake in Randgold Res Ltd (GOLD) by 14.58% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Plancorp Llc bought 4,210 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.27% with the market. The institutional investor held 33,095 shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.23M, up from 28,885 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Plancorp Llc who had been investing in Randgold Res Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.77B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.41% or $0.34 during the last trading session, reaching $82.87. About 400,428 shares traded. Randgold Resources Limited (NASDAQ:GOLD) has risen 7.63% since March 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.07% the S&P500. 
Meritage Portfolio Management decreased its stake in Lyondellbasell Industries Nv (LYB) by 44.24% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Meritage Portfolio Management sold 28,465 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.71% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 35,880 shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.55M, down from 64,345 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Meritage Portfolio Management who had been investing in Lyondellbasell Industries Nv for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $44.30B market cap company. The stock increased 2.66% or $2.91 during the last trading session, reaching $112.28. About 1.86M shares traded. LyondellBasell Industries N.V. (NYSE:LYB) has risen 0.33% since March 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 16.37% the S&P500. 
Meritage Portfolio Management, which manages about $1.31 billion and $1.02 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Cemex S A Spon Adr (NYSE:CX) by 172,753 shares to 472,779 shares, valued at $4.29 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3,128 shares in the quarter, for a total of 172,976 shares, and has risen its stake in Eagle Materials (NYSE:EXP). 
Analysts await LyondellBasell Industries N.V. (NYSE:LYB) to report earnings on April, 27. They expect $2.81 earnings per share, up 24.34% or $0.55 from last year’s $2.26 per share. LYB’s profit will be $1.11 billion for 9.99 P/E if the $2.81 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by LyondellBasell Industries N.V. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 2.93% EPS growth. 
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.84 in Q3 2017. Its down 0.12, from 0.96 in 2017Q2. It dropped, as 52 investors sold LYB shares while 276 reduced holdings. 88 funds opened positions while 187 raised stakes. 287.42 million shares or 0.30% less from 288.30 million shares in 2017Q2 were reported.
